## Usage

# charly.yml

## Used In Boxes

Not currently used in any enabled boxes. Depends on `google-cloud` + `nodejs`; the
Gemini CLI is provided by the `gemini` candy (which pins `@google/gemini-cli`), so a
composing box that also composes `gemini` keeps its pinned version.
